description:
Checks a list of tickers before a measurement: which have usable price history, which
        do not, and the closest listing where a symbol is ambiguous. Use it when the
        tickers are already written down; when only a name is known, search_symbols.
        base puts the listing in that currency first where a symbol trades in several
        (default USD). It measures nothing.

base.description: Currency every figure is expressed in (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD…). Default USD.
base.title: Base

name: validate_symbols

data.description: Where the prices came from and what was missing or repaired.

as_of.description: Last date of price history used.

missing.description: Tickers with no usable history (left out).

standins.description: Holdings measured through a stand-in with longer history: ticker, proxy, index, from, until, evidence.

suggestions.description: Per ambiguous ticker: the closest listing.

valid.description: Per ticker: true when it has usable price history.

title: Check symbols before measuring
